quests.title: The Exile: Sprouting

dialogue.t: Do you really have a way to grow roses through the power of <color=#00E1FFFF>Dendro</color>?
Can you wield Dendro? Are you someone with a Vision?
I haven't met anyone like that in a long time. What a nostalgic feeling...
It should be fine now, right, Miss Sabbah?
That's right, they should sprout soon if powered by Dendro. Let's just wait for a while...

dialogue.sit: Gradually, sprouts begin peeking out of the soil.
They stop growing after sprouting a few leaves.

dialogue.t: They're sprouting! Paimon knew you could do just about anything, {NICKNAME}!
The results were immediate, as I thought... Thank you.

dialogue.sit: Too bad there are no flowers yet.

dialogue.t: Oh, that's normal. You can't rush such things.
Plants have to go through stages of growth. That you were able to make them sprout is already quite amazing.
Give the roses some more time to take in the nourishment. It will be better for them as well.
I'm very grateful to you as it is. I wouldn't wish to bother you further.
Just drop by and see them in your spare time. That would be enough.

quests.description: The Sumeru Roses planted by Sabbah never grow. Try to help her.
